name: std::ranges::adjacent_view<V,N>::iterator<Const>::operator[]

declarations.code:
constexpr auto operator[](difference_type n) const

    requires ranges::random_access_range<Base>;

intro:
Returns an element at specified relative location.

Let current_ be an underlying array of iterators.

Equivalent to:

return /*tuple-transform*/([&](auto& i) -> decltype(auto) { return i[n]; }, current_);

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
n

 -

 position relative to current location

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The element at displacement n relative to the current location.

summary: Returns an element at specified relative location.
